svg.text: Teryx OS wiring, sheet 'lights'. Made from config/wiring.yaml by `python -m teryx wiring`. Don't edit this file.
Labels: wire id, size, fuse (if the wire has its own), and anything in between. Faded = optional. Hover for notes. Full table: docs/wiring/README.md

g.title: LT17: RELAYS.NO1 -> FLOOD_L.pos - light.rear, auto on in reverse
FB: Blade fuse block - Needs 16 ways. The 12-way on the parts list is too small, so use an 18 to 20-way or two 12-ways

RELAYS: 8-ch relay board - Mechanical 5 V relays with opto and JD-VCC jumper (AliExpress cart). The solid state G3MB-202P board Sam has is AC only and won't turn off on 12 V DC. JD-VCC jumper off, coils on 5 V, inputs from 3.3 V
MOSFET: 5-ch MOSFET board (low side) - Logic-level MOSFETs that fully turn on from 3.3 V
FLOOD_L: Rear flood left (4 in pod) - Outside of the roll cage mounting plate. Also the reverse light
FLOOD_R: Rear flood right (4 in pod)
